shipped-content.description: Current checked-in covering looks; authored architecture should encode identity shifts.

altered-zero-look.description: Previous benchmark profile: zero hue, strength and lightness for every covering; requests an altered desaturated appearance.

timestampQuery.precision: Implementation-dependent quantization. Raw uint64 values, zeros and observed duration divisibility are retained.

timingScope.cpu: Synchronous renderer.draw call, including identical benchmark counter/timestamp descriptor hooks. No await inside the interval.
timingScope.gpu: Elapsed time from beginning to end of the actual render pass. Excludes uploads, pre-pass queue waiting, readback and JavaScript promise resumption; may include GPU preemption or scheduling, so it is not pure occupied shader time.
timingScope.cadence: Differences between consecutive requestAnimationFrame callback timestamps. Refresh-limited cadence is not a performance acceptance test.
timingScope.protocol: One draw per visible animation frame. No per-frame completion fence, query resolve or map. One query resolve/copy/submit/map after each measured arm block.

metadata.allocationScope: GPU buffer/texture allocations are counted. Query resources and sample buffers are preallocated. JavaScript heap allocation and driver padding are unmeasured.

armDefinitions.baselineHistorical: Pinned baseline renderer with pinned historical geometry for the final logical lot.
armDefinitions.candidateHistorical: Current renderer with the exact same historical geometry and dynamic bytes.
armDefinitions.candidateFinal: Current renderer with authored architecture geometry for the same logical lot.

gpu.resolutionNote: Durations are timestamp differences in nanoseconds, converted to milliseconds. The observed common divisor is descriptive, not proof of timer precision. Zero durations are retained; an all-zero block cannot establish cost.

notes: Task-owned browser context closed after final validation and extraction.
All 1156 candidate floors have exact identity color adjustment, derived from the shipped content.
GPU timestamps report render-pass elapsed time and may include GPU preemption. Quantized zero-duration samples are retained.
CPU and render-pass p95 distributions are separate and must not be added or subtracted as component contributions.
